Woodgreen Pets Charity on Instagram: "‘Lurcher’ is an umbrella term for any Sighthound crossed with another breed. E.g. a Greyhound x Border Collie. That’s why they can look so different. They’re an incredibly goofy breed, full of personality, and always ready to make you laugh. 

Most people think Lurchers need a tonne of exercise and spend their days zooming around. And whilst they can be super speedy (running up to 40 mph to be exact!), they’re often more partial to a quick sprint. They’re professional sleepers, and a contented Lurcher will snooze for hours, and hours… And hours.

Lurchers can be a sociable breed, and they often LOVE other Lurchers. They’re not as friendly to small pets though, as they can have a strong chase-drive. If you have an unsecure garden, they might not be the best fit. 

We think Lurchers can make the most incredible pets! Interested to know if they could be a match for you? Try our Pet Explorer quiz. Link in bio. 

#Lurchers #WoodgreenPetsCharity #DogBreeds #LurchersOfInstagram"
